references.label: ESMA MiCA Article 2: MiCA scope and exclusions
ESMA MiCA Article 3: EMT must reference one official currency and an issuer
Avant: savUSD is a yield-bearing senior-tranche token received by staking avUSD

applicabilityBasis.summary: Issuer documentation establishes that savUSD is a senior yield-bearing wrapper received by staking avUSD, with an accruing exchange rate and conversion back to avUSD. Under owner ruling D17, these mechanics alone do not establish a GENIUS exclusion. Applicability remains unclear pending qualified token-specific analysis of holder repayment obligations and any securities or deposit exclusion; authorization research is separate.

references.label: GENIUS Act text: payment stablecoin definition and yield restriction
Avant: savUSD senior tranche and accruing exchange rate

genius.notes: The prior 2026-08-14 editorial assessment treated savUSD as a non-payment-token from its variable avUSD conversion. The 2026-10-01 D17 review withdraws that definitive GENIUS classification pending qualified token-specific legal analysis, without asserting payment-stablecoin scope or authorization. The MiCA assessment is unchanged by this U.S.-only ruling.
